title: DesktopPhase05RequestPayloadV1
description: The closed set of request payloads the twelve Phase-05 operations accept. No payload can name a web destination, send input, carry a free file path, or raise the trust of a memory.
$comment: لا فعل متصفّح ولا فعل حاسوب من العارض، ولا ترقية ذاكرة. الأفعال تبدأ من زمن تشغيل المهمّة عبر بوابة الأدوات وحدها.

MemoryListRequestV1.title: MemoryListRequestV1
MemoryListRequestV1.description: Lists memory entries by scope, type, status, owner or text. Deleted entries are not listed unless DELETED is asked for. No side effect.

MemoryGetRequestV1.title: MemoryGetRequestV1
MemoryGetRequestV1.description: Reads one entry with its content, lineage and conflicts. Records a USER_VIEW access.

MemoryDeleteRequestV1.title: MemoryDeleteRequestV1
MemoryDeleteRequestV1.description: Deletes an entry from the store: its content, subject and sources are erased, not hidden.

BrowserSessionListRequestV1.title: BrowserSessionListRequestV1
BrowserSessionListRequestV1.description: Lists browser sessions, optionally for one mission. No side effect.

BrowserSessionGetRequestV1.title: BrowserSessionGetRequestV1
BrowserSessionGetRequestV1.description: Reads one browser session with its action history and downloads. No side effect.

BrowserSessionCancelRequestV1.title: BrowserSessionCancelRequestV1
BrowserSessionCancelRequestV1.description: Stops a browser session. No further browser action runs in it.

ComputerSessionListRequestV1.title: ComputerSessionListRequestV1
ComputerSessionListRequestV1.description: Lists computer sessions, optionally for one mission. No side effect.

ComputerSessionGetRequestV1.title: ComputerSessionGetRequestV1
ComputerSessionGetRequestV1.description: Reads one computer session with its actions and observation digests. No side effect.

ComputerSessionCancelRequestV1.title: ComputerSessionCancelRequestV1
ComputerSessionCancelRequestV1.description: Stops a computer session. No further input is sent in it.

ComputerWindowListRequestV1.title: ComputerWindowListRequestV1
ComputerWindowListRequestV1.description: Lists the visible windows so the user can grant one, and the grants of one mission. The inventory never reaches a model. No side effect.

ComputerTargetGrantRequestV1.title: ComputerTargetGrantRequestV1
ComputerTargetGrantRequestV1.description: Grants one window to one mission. The host reads the window identity from the system, never from this payload.

ComputerTargetRevokeRequestV1.title: ComputerTargetRevokeRequestV1
ComputerTargetRevokeRequestV1.description: Revokes a window grant. Actions bound to it are refused afterwards.
